events.name: Archaeological Find
events.hook: A remote ruin in your lands may hold relics of the people who came before.

events.name: Assassination Attempt
events.hook: Someone has hired killers to strike at the court.

events.name: Bandit Activity
events.hook: Caravans along the roads are being robbed.

events.name: Boomtown
events.hook: Trade is booming in one of your smaller towns.

events.name: Building Demand

setup.hint: Pick a settlement track stage the townsfolk want built (one that isn't yet), or one they want torn down.

events.altResolve: Commit this settlement's next builds to the demand instead of rolling.
events.hook: Townsfolk are demanding a building be raised, or torn down.

events.name: Crop Failure
events.hook: Blight has struck the fields.

criticalFailure.gm: This farmland is destroyed. Remove it on the map.

events.name: Cult Activity
events.hook: Citizens are vanishing. Whispers speak of a hidden temple.

events.name: Diplomatic Overture
events.hook: An envoy has arrived seeking an audience.

events.name: Discovery
events.hook: Your scholars believe they are close to a breakthrough.

events.name: Drug Den
events.hook: Something is poisoning the back streets.

criticalFailure.gm: The den's street is wrecked: one of that settlement's tracks other than Homes (players' choice) loses a stage (use − on the Settlements tab), and the den moves elsewhere in town.

events.name: Economic Surge
events.hook: Markets are booming across the realm.

events.name: Expansion Demand
events.hook: Settlers are restless for new land.

events.name: Festive Invitation

gift.note: Bring up to 4 dice of next month's income as gifts.

events.hook: An ally invites your court to their festival.

events.name: Feud
events.hook: Two towns' leading families are at each other's throats.

events.name: Food Shortage
events.hook: The granaries are running low.

events.name: Food Surplus
events.hook: The harvest is bountiful.

events.name: Good Weather
events.hook: A run of fine weather lifts every spirit.

events.name: Inquisition
events.hook: Zealots are stirring the crowds against their neighbours.

failure.gm: The targeted settlement track loses a stage (use − on the Settlements tab).

events.name: Justice Prevails
events.hook: A long-standing injustice has finally been put right.

events.name: Land Rush
events.hook: Settlers are squabbling over land just past your border.

criticalSuccess.gm: Mark the hex claimed and add the settlers' farmland or work site.

events.name: Local Disaster
events.hook: Fire, flood or collapse has struck a settlement.

failure.gm: One of that settlement's tracks (players' choice) loses a stage (use − on the Settlements tab).

criticalFailure.gm: As many of that settlement's tracks as the Decay rolled (players' choice) each lose a stage (use − on the Settlements tab).

events.name: Monster Activity
events.hook: Something large is killing livestock out in the wilds.

failure.gm: The nearest farmland or work site is destroyed. Remove it on the map.

criticalFailure.gm: As failure, then it reaches the nearest settlement: if that settlement has Walls, its Walls lose a stage; otherwise one of its tracks (players' choice) loses a stage (use − on the Settlements tab).

events.name: Natural Disaster
events.hook: Storm, fire or flood is sweeping across the land.

failure.gm: One farmland or work site is destroyed. Remove it on the map.

criticalFailure.gm: 1d6 farmlands or work sites are destroyed (Decay 1 each).

events.name: Nature's Blessing
events.hook: A rare wonder of nature has the whole realm talking.

events.name: New Subjects
events.hook: Newcomers ask to settle under your banner.

events.name: Noblesse Oblige
events.hook: A wealthy family offers to beautify the town.

events.name: Outstanding Success
events.hook: One of your citizens has made something remarkable.

events.name: Pilgrimage
events.hook: Pilgrims are streaming toward your shrines.

events.name: Plague
events.hook: Sickness is spreading through the streets.

events.name: Political Calm
events.hook: For once, the court is quiet and the people approve.

events.name: Public Scandal
events.hook: One of your officials is at the centre of an embarrassing affair.

events.name: Remarkable Treasure
events.hook: Foreign adventurers struck it rich in your wilds.

criticalFailure.note: These adventurers may return as rivals.

events.name: Sacrifices
events.hook: People are being taken from the roads at night.

events.name: Sensational Crime
events.hook: A notorious criminal is making fools of the watch.

events.name: Squatters

whileActive.gm: Squatters camp in the settlement: its Homes can't be raised until this ends.

events.hook: Families with nowhere to go have camped in the town square.

events.name: Undead Uprising
events.hook: The dead are not staying in their graves.

criticalFailure.gm: One of that settlement's tracks other than Faith (players' choice) loses a stage (use − on the Settlements tab).

events.name: Unexpected Find
events.hook: Workers have dug up something that glows.

from.gm: Give the PCs a permanent item, or four consumables, of kingdom level (AP rule; this is the AP's own reward, not kingdom gold).

events.name: Vandals
events.hook: Someone is wrecking property under cover of night.

criticalFailure.gm: One of that settlement's tracks (players' choice) loses a stage (use − on the Settlements tab).

events.name: Visiting Celebrity
events.hook: A famous visitor is coming to town.

events.name: Wealthy Immigrant
events.hook: A rich foreigner wants to build an estate in your capital.

storyEvents.name: Public Outbreak
storyEvents.hook: Fear of the bloom-curse is spreading.

storyEvents.name: Too Close To Home
storyEvents.hook: Something burst out of a citizen and is loose in the countryside.

storyEvents.name: Urban Outbreak
storyEvents.hook: A monster has erupted in the middle of town.
